name: steel-roller
flavor_text: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.
effect_text_extend: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.
